name: 158.2 — a rule lands on a surface of yours when it is armed, named or resized
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 158.2: a layout rule installed before a surface is built lands on its arming tick (a widget, a window, a control, a mirror, a chain), a surface's own anchor is re-derived when it resizes, and :name written late lands its rule at once and refuses from another tree's handler.
